Keep the drawer from creating records or invoking SuiteScript outside the approved server adapter path. If no runnerTaskId exists, the control remains hidden. If runnerTaskId exists, the control polls result capture and normalizes pending, completed, and adapter-error responses. Completed results must remain blocked from final-name mutation until W151 validates numeric ids and supported NetSuite URLs. Preserve no drawer writes, no drawer transaction writes, consultant confirmation, state authority and handoff parity, internal runner ownership, rollback by disabling server flags, and no active Open links without real URLs. Output poll-control implementation contract, guarded harness, trace samples, W179 report, visual testing decision blocked until completed result import, and best next Codex prompt.
